resources.string: SIMULATED PUMP – NO INSULIN IS DELIVERED
The Insight pump has not answered for more than 15 minutes. Check that it is nearby, has battery and Bluetooth is on. Trio cannot control the pump until this is fixed.
The app stopped unexpectedly and was restarted automatically. Open the app to check the log.
Bluetooth permissions are missing, so the bridge cannot run. Open the app and grant them.
Android did not allow the bridge to start in the background. Tap to open the app and start it.
An earlier version of InsightBridge renamed this phone\'s Bluetooth name to InsightBridge-XXXX. This version no longer does that. You can set the name back in Settings > About phone > Device name.
